regime_context: The Canada/TSX detector shows a broad, two-leader rotation (not one-narrative), with Oil & Gas Producers clearly ahead of Gold Miners, but cross-sectional momentum ranked near-zero for alpha, so this is a discipline/risk-control read, not a forecast. Only 8 of 16 themes are trend-gate eligible, and the detector's one validated edge is drawdown reduction, not return prediction.
emerging_watch: Watch for a CONFIRMED leadership handoff from Oil & Gas Producers to Gold Miners: the condition that would retire this watch is Gold Miners' breadth expanding above 0.50 while Oil & Gas' breadth falls below 0.50 over a 10-day rolling window.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas is the #1 focus theme with the highest score and a durable breadth (0.786) and solid durability bar (0.68). Its trend-gate eligibility and standing as the current leader support retaining overweight exposure, while the crowded flag (crowding_z 1.04) cautions against adding aggressively rather than fading it.
theses.dissent: Broad breadth with a high crowding flag can mark a late-stage narrative; a fade would be the documented failure mode, but new money chasing it may face idiosyncratic drawdown risk if attention has already peaked.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO closes below its 50-day average for 10 consecutive trading sessions before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the #2 challenger with eligibility and a positive score, but its breadth (0.267) is narrow, suggesting leadership is concentrated in fewer names. The overweight lean is modest, supported by trend-gate eligibility and a non-crowded positioning (crowding_z 0.2), not by momentum forecast.
theses.dissent: Narrow breadth in a challenger theme often fails to expand into broad leadership; Gold's momentum could stall relative to Oil & Gas, leaving it vulnerable to mean-reversion.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO lags XEG.TO by more than 5% over any 10-day window before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology has a positive durability bar (0.69) and high breadth (0.70), but its score is slightly negative (-0.008) and it is crowded (crowding_z 1.25). The avoid lean reflects the crowding flag as a caution against adding to an already-attention-heavy theme, not a fade call.
theses.dissent: Technology's high durability and breadth could support a sustained trend despite current crowding; avoiding may miss continuation if the lead narrative rolls over and rotation broadens.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO outperforms XEG.TO by more than 3% over any 10-day window before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
